title: westspace configuration
description: Declarative description of a Zephyr west workspace: flavor (vanilla or NCS), build targets, and per-target configurations.

ncs.description: Absent => vanilla Zephyr (upstream zephyrproject-rtos). Present => nRF Connect SDK (sdk-nrf).

enabled.description: Set false to keep NCS settings on file but build vanilla.

version.description: sdk-nrf revision: release tag (e.g. v2.7.0), branch, or commit SHA.

manifest_file.description: West manifest inside manifest_dir used for `west init -l --mf` when NCS is enabled. The template ships this alongside the vanilla manifest_file.

manifest_dir.description: Directory containing the west manifest, passed to `west init -l`.

manifest_file.description: West manifest inside manifest_dir used for `west init -l --mf`. Overridden by ncs.manifest_file when NCS is enabled.

toolchains.description: Zephyr SDK GNU toolchains to install during `westspace init`, e.g. ['arm-zephyr-eabi']. Vanilla only (NCS uses the nrfutil toolchain bundle). Omit the key to install every toolchain; use an empty list to install none (SDK and host tools only).

default_target.description: Target used when `westspace build` is invoked with no target. If omitted and only one target exists, that target is used.

targets.description: Named build targets. Keys are target names used on the CLI as `target` or `target:config`.

source.description: Application source directory passed to `west build` (relative to workspace root).

board.description: Zephyr board target, e.g. nrf52840dk/nrf52840 or native_sim/native/64.

sysbuild.description: Build with sysbuild (`--sysbuild`). Defaults to west's own default when unset.

default_config.description: Config used when the target is named without `:config`. If omitted, a config keyed `default` is required.

configs.description: Named configurations for this target. Keys are config names used on the CLI as `target:config`.

config.description: A build variant of its parent target: extra DTS overlays, Kconfig fragments, snippets, and build args.

overlays.description: Devicetree overlay files (relative to the target source dir).

conf.description: Kconfig fragment files, applied via EXTRA_CONF_FILE (relative to the target source dir).

cmake_args.description: Extra args passed through to CMake after `--`.

west_args.description: Extra args passed to `west build` itself.

build_dir.description: Build output directory. If unset, westspace derives one (e.g. build/<target>-<config>).
